name: Bush / Potted Tomato
watering_needs: Requires regular, uniform moisture. Sensitive to dry-wet oscillations.
hydrogel_synergy: Exceptional (+42% yield stability). Hydrogel eliminates moisture swings that cause calcium deficiency and blossom-end rot.
growth_timeline: 65–80 days to first harvest; productive for 4–5 months
care_instructions: Provide sturdy bamboo staking or cage as fruit clusters develop.
Prune lower yellowing leaves touching the soil to prevent fungal splash infection.
Apply 1 handful of vermicompost and neem cake every 15 days.
potential_challenges: Prone to early blight in high humidity; avoid overhead foliar watering.

name: Cherry Tomato
watering_needs: Consistent root hydration. Drought causes premature flower drop.
hydrogel_synergy: High. Hydrogel buffer keeps substrate at 55–60% VWC, maximizing sugar concentration and preventing fruit splitting.
preferred_medium: Cocopeat mix enriched with organic compost
growth_timeline: 55–70 days to harvest; prolific heavy producer
care_instructions: Easy container grower; ideal for 10L to 15L grow bags.
Tolerates container confinement better than standard beefsteak tomatoes.
Harvest regularly to stimulate continuous flowering.
potential_challenges: Watch for whiteflies on tender undersides during warm spells.

name: Green Chilli
watering_needs: Moderate watering; allow top 1 inch to dry slightly between cycles.
hydrogel_synergy: Very High. Hydrogel provides sub-surface moisture without surface waterlogging, preventing damping-off and leaf curl.
growth_timeline: 60–75 days to first harvest; perennial for 1.5–2 years in Tamil Nadu
care_instructions: Pinch growing tip at 6 inches height to promote bushy lateral branching.
Spray diluted sour buttermilk or neem oil monthly to deter leaf-curl virus vectors.
Thrives in warm, sunny terrace exposures.
potential_challenges: Thrips and aphids can transmit leaf-curl virus; maintain air circulation.

name: Brinjal / Eggplant
watering_needs: High water uptake during flowering and fruit fattening.
hydrogel_synergy: Substantial. Absorbs heavy irrigation pulses and supplies roots during peak midday heat, preventing afternoon drooping.
preferred_medium: Rich potting mix with high organic matter (30% vermicompost)
growth_timeline: 70–85 days to harvest; robust continuous producer
care_instructions: Requires minimum 15L grow bag depth for taproot exploration.
Feed with fermented mustard cake or seaweed extract every 3 weeks.
Check shoot tips weekly for shoot and fruit borer entry holes.
potential_challenges: Shoot and fruit borer; prune affected shoot tips immediately.

name: Okra / Lady's Finger
watering_needs: Moderate, regular watering. Heat-tolerant but pods turn fibrous under drought.
hydrogel_synergy: High. Keeps pods succulent, tender, and fast-growing without water waste.
preferred_medium: Loamy cocopeat blend with neutral pH (6.0–6.8)
growth_timeline: 45–55 days to first pod picking; extremely fast cycle
care_instructions: Direct sow seeds 1 inch deep in 12L–15L bags.
Harvest young pods every 2 days to encourage continuous fruiting.
Tolerates hot terrace rooftop sun better than most vegetables.
potential_challenges: Yellow vein mosaic virus; choose YVMV-resistant seed varieties.

name: Bush French Beans
watering_needs: Moderate, steady moisture. Do not let soil bake completely dry.
hydrogel_synergy: Moderate. Fixes atmospheric nitrogen, leaving potting mix enriched for subsequent crops.
preferred_medium: Light cocopeat potting soil with good aeration
growth_timeline: 50–60 days to harvest; compact non-climbing habit
care_instructions: Compact bush form requires no tall trellising.
Plant 2–3 plants in a single 15L rectangular grow bag.
Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer which causes lush leaves but few pods.
potential_challenges: Sensitive to high heat over 35°C during flower set.

name: Amaranth / Red Keerai
watering_needs: Light, daily watering via fine micro-sprayer or drip.
hydrogel_synergy: Substantial for shallow containers. Prevents rapid surface drying on hot terraces.
growth_timeline: 25–30 days for microgreens / tender greens; 45 days for full stalks
care_instructions: Broadcast seeds mixed with fine sand for even spacing in rectangular crates.
Can be harvested by cut-and-come-again method 3 to 4 times.
Rich in dietary iron, calcium, and vitamins.
potential_challenges: Damping off if seeds are sown too densely without ventilation.

name: Indian Spinach / Palak
watering_needs: Keep potting mix consistently cool and moist.
hydrogel_synergy: High. Keeps shallow container root zone hydrated under direct sunlight.
growth_timeline: 30–40 days to first leaf harvest; multiple flushes
care_instructions: Ideal for partial shade terrace corners or under shade-netting.
Harvest outer mature leaves, allowing central crown to regenerate.
Bolts (flowers prematurely) in high summer heat.
potential_challenges: Leaf miner tracks; remove affected leaves promptly.

name: White Radish
watering_needs: Uniform moisture ensures crisp, mild, non-fibrous roots.
hydrogel_synergy: Very High. Uneven moisture makes radishes pungent, woody, and cracked.
growth_timeline: 35–45 days from seed to harvest
care_instructions: Ensure container depth is at least 10–12 inches for root expansion.
Do not transplant; direct sow seeds 1/2 inch deep.
Thin seedlings to 3 inches apart after germination.
potential_challenges: Root forking if medium has dense compacted lumps.

name: Spearmint / Pudina
watering_needs: Prefers consistently moist soil; wilted easily by dry midday winds.
hydrogel_synergy: Critical (+55% retention improvement). Prevents thin, shallow runner roots from baking in terrace heat.
growth_timeline: 20–30 days from stem cuttings; vigorous creeping runner
care_instructions: Propagates easily from kitchen market mint stems placed in water for 3 days.
Grow in dedicated shallow wide pot to prevent it overtaking companion plants.
Trim stems frequently to stimulate dense, aromatic foliage.
potential_challenges: Invasive root runners if mixed in same container with slow growers.

name: Coriander / Cilantro
watering_needs: Gentle, light moisture. Heavy waterlogging causes root rot.
hydrogel_synergy: High. Keeps upper 2 inches of potting mix uniformly damp without surface crusting.
growth_timeline: 30–45 days to harvest; continuous succession sowing
care_instructions: Crush whole coriander seeds gently into halves before soaking overnight.
Sow shallowly in wide trays or 8-inch deep grow bags.
Place in mild morning sun; move to partial shade if afternoon temperatures exceed 32°C.
potential_challenges: Bolts quickly into flower under sudden heat spikes.

name: Holy Basil / Tulsi
watering_needs: Water when top 1 inch becomes dry. Tolerates dry spells well.
hydrogel_synergy: Moderate. Protects root ball during festival absences or travel.
preferred_medium: Well-draining red soil + compost with coarse sand
growth_timeline: 40–60 days to mature plant; perennial sacred medicinal bush
care_instructions: Pinch off flower spikes (manjari) regularly to keep the bush leafy and vibrant.
Requires well-draining container; hates stagnant water around base.
Sacred medicinal plant widely revered for tea and immunity.
potential_challenges: Sooty mold if attacked by aphids; spray dilute neem solution.

name: Curry Leaf Tree
watering_needs: Deep thorough watering, then allow top 2 inches to dry slightly.
hydrogel_synergy: Very High. Deep container root systems thrive on the steady capillary moisture buffer.
preferred_medium: Heavy loamy potting mix enriched with aged cow dung manure
growth_timeline: Perennial shrub/tree; harvest leaves indefinitely after 3 months
care_instructions: Use a minimum 20L to 30L container or large grow bag.
Feed sour buttermilk diluted in water (1:10) once every fortnight to boost fragrance.
Prune main stem periodically to encourage multi-stem branching.
potential_challenges: Psyllid pests on tender new leaf shoots; treat with organic neem spray.

name: Sweet / Italian Basil
watering_needs: Water consistently to prevent wilting of broad, aromatic leaves.
hydrogel_synergy: High. Keeps broad culinary leaves lush and intensely aromatic.
growth_timeline: 35–45 days to first harvest; prolific culinary herb
care_instructions: Pinch flower heads as soon as they form to prolong leaf production.
Top companion plant for potted tomatoes; deters whiteflies and hornworms.
Excellent for fresh pesto, pastas, and salads.
potential_challenges: Fusarium wilt if soil remains overly saturated without aeration.

name: African Marigold
watering_needs: Moderate; water at soil level to keep flower heads dry.
hydrogel_synergy: High. Keeps heavy flower heads turgid during hot afternoon hours.
growth_timeline: 45–60 days to full bloom; blooms continuously for months
care_instructions: Essential companion plant for terrace gardens: roots exude alpha-terthienyl, suppressing root-knot nematodes.
Attracts hoverflies, bees, and ladybugs that prey on garden pests.
Deadhead spent flowers to stimulate continuous prolific blooming.
potential_challenges: Red spider mites during dry dusty weather; mist foliage occasionally.

name: Dwarf / Container Hibiscus
watering_needs: Regular watering during flowering season. Drops buds if allowed to desiccate.
hydrogel_synergy: Exceptional. Prevents soil drying shocks that trigger premature flower bud abortion.
preferred_medium: Acidic to neutral rich potting mix (pH 6.0–6.5)
growth_timeline: Perennial flowering shrub; blooms all year round in Tamil Nadu
care_instructions: Apply high-potassium organic fertilizer (banana peel tea or wood ash) monthly.
Prune lightly once or twice a year to promote bushy shape and new flower wood.
Prized for hair oils and health tonics.
potential_challenges: Mealybugs love tender calyxes; spray soap-water emulsion immediately.

name: Zinnia
watering_needs: Moderate; drought-hardy once established.
hydrogel_synergy: High. Keeps vibrant petals brilliant without drooping under hot sun.
growth_timeline: 45–55 days from seed to explosion of bright multi-colored blooms
care_instructions: One of the best butterfly and bee attractors for terrace container gardens.
Water only at the root base; avoid wetting petals to prevent fungal spots.
Available in dazzling pink, red, orange, and yellow daisy-like blooms.
potential_challenges: Powdery mildew if planted too densely in stagnant air.

name: Arabian Jasmine / Madurai Malli
watering_needs: Moderate; water deeply, allow slight drying between cycles.
hydrogel_synergy: High. Sustains root moisture during warm summer flowering flushes.
preferred_medium: Loamy soil + compost + bone meal / organic rock phosphate
growth_timeline: Perennial vine/shrub; famous heavy summer flower flushes
care_instructions: Prune back shoots by 50% in January/February to trigger abundant summer bud development.
Defoliate older leaves before blooming cycle to focus energy on floral buds.
World-famous intoxicating evening fragrance.
potential_challenges: Bud worm during humid monsoon periods; inspect unopened buds.

name: Snake Plant / Mother-in-Law's Tongue
sunlight_req_text: 1–4 hours indirect or low light (tolerates full shade)
watering_needs: Very low; water once every 7–14 days. Root rot occurs if overwatered.
hydrogel_synergy: Low (Not required). Succulent rhizomes store ample water.
growth_timeline: Slow, architectural vertical growth; virtually immortal
care_instructions: NASA clean-air certified; absorbs benzene, formaldehyde, and xylene.
Releases oxygen at night (CAM photosynthesis), making it ideal near terrace sit-outs.
Water only when potting soil is bone dry.
potential_challenges: Root rot from overwatering or poorly draining containers.

name: Golden Pothos / Money Plant
sunlight_req_text: 2–4 hours filtered or bright indirect light
watering_needs: Water when top 1 inch feels dry; loves occasional foliar misting.
hydrogel_synergy: Moderate. Keeps hanging baskets and moss poles hydrated longer.
growth_timeline: Fast-growing evergreen trailing climber
care_instructions: Can trail downward from hanging planters or climb upward on a coir moss pole.
Direct harsh midday terrace sun can scorch the glossy variegated foliage; keep in semi-shade.
Propagates effortlessly from simple single-node stem cuttings.
potential_challenges: Leaf scorching if placed in unshaded afternoon sun.

name: Aloe Vera
watering_needs: Very low; thick gel-filled leaves store water for weeks.
hydrogel_synergy: Low (Self-storing). Avoid hydrogel in aloe pots to prevent excess moisture.
preferred_medium: Sandy, free-draining potting soil (sand : compost : soil 1:1:1)
growth_timeline: Perennial clumping succulent; harvest mature outer leaves
care_instructions: Fabulous medicinal gel for skin burns, cooling drinks, and plant rooting hormone.
Produces offset 'pups' rapidly that can be potted into new containers.
Requires drainage holes in pot to prevent water buildup.
potential_challenges: Leaf softening and black root rot if waterlogged.

name: Container Strawberry
watering_needs: Shallow root system requires consistent moisture without soggy crown.
hydrogel_synergy: Very High (+48% survival). Shallow roots dry out fast in terrace grow bags; hydrogel buffers root zone perfectly.
growth_timeline: 60–75 days from runner planting to sweet red berries
care_instructions: Plant with crown exactly level with potting mix surface; never bury crown.
Ideal for hanging baskets or vertical tiered planters on terrace.
Mulch with dry straw or dry coco-chips to keep developing berries off damp soil.
potential_challenges: Struggles when ambient temperatures exceed 34°C; best grown Oct–Feb in TN.

name: Dwarf Papaya (Red Lady)
watering_needs: High water uptake during rapid vegetative surge and heavy fruit setting.
hydrogel_synergy: Exceptional. Prevents soil drying in large 35L containers on hot rooftops.
preferred_medium: Rich loamy soil + coarse compost (50:50) with exceptional drainage
growth_timeline: Flowers at 2.5 feet height; harvests in 8–9 months
care_instructions: Requires large 30L–50L drum or heavy-duty grow bag with multiple drainage holes.
Heavy feeder: topdress with 2 kg compost + neem cake monthly.
Dwarf bisexual variety that fruits at low height, safe for windy terrace gardens.
potential_challenges: Extremely sensitive to waterlogging (stem collar rot); keep base well drained.

name: Capsicum / Bell Pepper
watering_needs: Consistent root moisture; soil moisture stress causes fruit drop or thin walls.
hydrogel_synergy: Very High (+38% water efficiency). Hydrogel maintains steady turgor pressure vital for thick, crunchy pericarp fruit walls.
growth_timeline: 70–85 days to harvest; continues yielding for 3–4 months
care_instructions: Support main stem with a light bamboo stake to prevent fruit weight toppling.
Feed with liquid vermicompost or seaweed extract every 12 days during flowering.
Pinch the first central blossom to encourage heavy lateral branching and higher total yield.
potential_challenges: Prone to thrips and leaf curl during hot dry spells; inspect leaf undersides weekly.
